title: THE PRICE OF FACES // THE CONTRACT OF THE HOOF
narrative: In the subterranean sanctuary of the Many-Faced God, the Kindly Man leads Arya to the iron ledger. The Faceless Men were founded by slaves in the volcanic mines of the Fourteen Flames. Their first gift was to their masters—the Doom of Valyria itself. The final entry in the book is signed in royal dragonblood: an iron bank bond to ensure dragons never rule the Seven Kingdoms again.

options.text: Infiltrate the mummer troupe bound for King's Landing as Mercy.
Steal a face from the wall and board the first galley to Westeros.
